I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I completely get that. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase.

A couple of quick things about Heirloom that might help your peace of mind:

All of our plants are grown by us at our nurseries in Oregon; we don’t resell from third-party growers.
Our roses are premium own-root plants grown in 1-gallon containers (not bare root), which means they tend to be longer-lived and recover better from stress.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, and perennials by a 90-day guarantee, so our garden advisors can work with you if something doesn’t perform as expected.
